PASS — #287, round 1, exact head 8653a193a26a364083443f5648e292d1c471205c, base a89e8cb64452ab92524bd41b93b9c74a7428c868. No correctness findings.

Both state renderers append "control context: <armed|unarmed>" when reported, followed by the daemon's human-step line. The producer sets that line only for unarmed seats (crates/daemon/src/http/mod.rs:3972-3977), so neither renderer needs a second policy. Absent fields leave the old text unchanged. The TS renderer adds these lines before existing deferral/size lines; the native renderer preserves its existing ordering.

The send renderer appends warnings once on either mutually exclusive receipt path. The existing held-FYI question warning remains byte-identical, as do receipts without warnings and cold-check lines. Raw --json bypasses human rendering; exit-code/admission logic is untouched.

Proof:
- just pr-freeze 287: FINAL, matching exact heads, CLEAN, latest checks green.
- PIJ_SHARED_TARGET="$(bash harness/scripts/cargo-target.sh)" just shared-build -- test --locked -p pij-cli --bin pij-rs state_ --then clippy --locked -p pij-cli --bin pij-rs -- -D warnings: exit 0; 7 state tests passed, macOS Clippy passed. Nice-only, four jobs, shared-build lock.
- Exact-head CI run 44718113663: Node 22/24 checks, Rust lint and Rust tests passed. Node 24 log explicitly records generation-routing.test.ts: 57 passed; full Vitest: 2368 passed, 7 skipped. Rust: 2648 passed, 6 skipped. Successful job 136226589927's explicit JUnit artifact 14620851686 records state_prints_the_control_context_and_the_human_step passing.
- Dependency-free extracted-source probe reused the two new TS assertion bodies and the existing held-FYI assertion: head green; both new assertions RED on base. Inverting the controlContext === undefined guard was killed by the existing state assertion. Three absent-field cards, four legacy receipts and raw JSON also retained exact bytes. This is an isolated renderer probe, not a local Vitest run.

Validation boundary: C25 forbids installing/linking node_modules here. harness boot reported NOT-READY; harness checks --quick exited 1 with eight missing-dependency/ambient-tool failures. It did not establish a green local full gate. Exact-head CI is the TS suite/typecheck/lint evidence; local macOS proof is scoped above. No product or review-worktree changes were made.

Cost: render only, in process and on demand. No added/changed loop, poll, timer, hook, sweep or process launch; zero new steady-state launches per second and no per-seat ticking cost.

Holding reviewer/287 until merge.

Harness retrospective: C25 review worktrees lack a first-class CI-backed checks mode, so readiness failures and ambient Biome skew must be separated manually from PR correctness. Magic wand: encode an exact-head review command that fetches successful-job CI receipts and reports LOCAL-UNAVAILABLE versus CI-PASS explicitly. Proposed follow-up, not a PR finding.
